videos.text:
@wonderful_ai's launch video for AI Gateway.
(1k likes on LinkedIn)
Let's analyze it.

It's a 'top of funnel' launch video. 

Mostly for awareness purposes, for cold audience, with 0 prior context.

So they decided to focus on the Problem.

Fair enough.

There are at least 4 types of a Problem hook (see my post here https://t.co/uXKS9otUfN).

But they chose the MOST DIFFICULT ONE: tension building.

It's when instead of naming a problem, you make them FEEL the tension (aka live through it). 

It reminds me of the Human Behavior v2 video (https://t.co/tKDmPUxjWr) made by my friend Nemanja Vukomanovic and his team. And style-wise, the Symphony video (https://t.co/yVzxTCQgCU) made by Wix Studio.

However, a good immersion and tension building takes about 20-30 seconds of the video, so there's never enough time left for the [Demo] part... especially in shorter TOFU 'promo' videos.

Fundamental formula: [Problem] -> [Solution] -> [A few ways to use it] -> [so that...] -> [Outro]

Amazing execution.
